A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.

The manual of the MA STAR two post lift carries an EC declaration of conformity to Directive 2006/42/EC. For a unit of the same model placed on the market on 1 March 2027, must the CE marking be followed by the identification number of a notified body?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Article 54 transitional provisions date of application 20 January 2027 / Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 articolo 54 disposizioni transitorie data di applicazione 20 gennaio 2027 macchine", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 CE marking notified body identification number / Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 marcatura CE numero di identificazione dell'organismo notificato", "Directive 2006/42/EC Article 16 CE marking notified body identification number Annex X / Direttiva 2006/42/CE articolo 16 marcatura CE numero di identificazione dell'organismo notificato allegato X", "MA STAR two post lift EC declaration of conformity Directive 2006/42/EC manual / MA STAR sollevatore a due colonne dichiarazione CE di conformità direttiva 2006/42/CE manuale d'uso"]}
